title: Synthesizability Prediction of Crystalline Structures with Structure-Aware Feature Learning and Uncertainty Quantification
abstract: arXiv:2510.19251v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Predicting which hypothetical inorganic crystals can be experimentally realized remains a central challenge in accelerating materials discovery. SyntheFormer is a positive-unlabeled framework that learns synthesizability directly from crystal structure, combining Fourier-transformed crystal properties (FTCP) representation with structure-aware feature extraction, Random-Forest feature selection, and a compact deep MLP classifier. The model is trained on historical data from 2011 through 2018 and evaluated prospectively on future years from 2019 to 2025, where the positive class constitutes only 1.02 percent of samples. Under this temporally separated evaluation, SyntheFormer achieves a test AUC of 0.735, AUPRC of 0.099 and 97.6 percent recall at 94.2 percent coverage with dual-threshold calibration. Direct prospective validation supports this result as two materials that were unlabeled at the time of data curation, Y6Fe(SiS7)2

translated_title: 基于结构感知特征学习与不确定性量化的晶体结构可合成性预测
translated_abstract: 预测哪些假设性无机晶体能够在实验上被实现，仍然是加速材料发现过程中的核心挑战。SyntheFormer是一个正例-未标注（positive-unlabeled）框架，它直接从晶体结构中学习可合成性，将傅里叶变换晶体性质（FTCP）表示与结构感知特征提取、随机森林特征选择以及紧凑的深度多层感知机分类器相结合。该模型在2011年至2018年的历史数据上训练，并在2019年至2025年的未来年份上进行前瞻性评估，其中正类样本仅占总样本的1.02%。在这种时间分离的评估条件下，SyntheFormer实现了0.735的测试AUC、0.099的AUPRC，并在双阈值校准下以94.2%的覆盖率达到了97.6%的召回率。直接的前瞻性验证支持了这一结果，因为在数据整理时尚未被标注的两种材料Y6Fe(SiS7)2……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SyntheFormer框架，通过结构感知特征学习与不确定性量化直接从晶体结构预测可合成性，在时间严格分离的前瞻性评估中，对仅占1.02%的极稀少可合成正类样本实现了高召回率预测，并通过新发现材料的前瞻性验证证实了其有效性。
en_tdlr: SyntheFormer is a positive-unlabeled framework that predicts the synthesizability of crystalline structures directly from crystal geometry using structure-aware feature learning and uncertainty quantification, achieving high recall on extremely rare positive samples under strictly temporally separated prospective evaluation.
